T-001 removes the six historical Validate steps, deletes scripts/verify-prepin-linux-evidence.ts, removes its three tests and exclusive helpers, and adds one Bun.YAML.parse guard; its absence check is red at baseline and green after, the whole parsed workflow equals baseline minus the six removed steps, and the guard, the retained focused C6/fixture selection, and typecheck pass. T-001.Title: Remove the six historical Validate steps, the verifier, and its tests; add the narrow absence guard

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Red first: the absence check below fails at baseline with the six step names, prepin-behavior, b53d13d, the verifier path, the three verifier titles, and the seven exclusive helpers all present. Then, and only these: in .github/workflows/validate.yml delete the six steps after Run local release consistency check (Checkout exact head for pre-pin behavior, Install exact-head dependencies, Stamp pre-pin behavior head, Run pre-pin controls, Require pre-pin behavior files, Upload pre-pin behavior JUnit); delete scripts/verify-prepin-linux-evidence.ts; and in scripts/audit-regressions.test.ts delete the three prepin linux verifier tests with their exclusive constants and helpers (PREPIN_TITLES, WorkflowStep, parseValidateSteps, simulatePrepin, prepinJunit, writeFakeGh, runPrepinVerifier) and replace them with one test under the describe prepin CI retirement. That test reads the real workflow with Bun.YAML.parse, rejects the six retired step names and the markers prepin-behavior and b53d13d, allows unrelated JUnit reports and artifact uploads, requires the retained Validate, Windows, and Dart job and step names, and proves planted retired steps and an innocent-named pre-pin step red and removal and unrelated JUnit/upload steps green. The whole parsed workflow equals the baseline document with exactly the six historical Validate steps removed; the guard, the retained focused C6/fixture selection, and typecheck pass. No whole suite here.

Verification.Command: bun -e 'const fs=require("fs");const wf=fs.readFileSync(".github/workflows/validate.yml","utf8");const tf=fs.readFileSync("scripts/audit-regressions.test.ts","utf8");const names=["Checkout exact head for pre-pin behavior","Install exact-head dependencies","Stamp pre-pin behavior head","Run pre-pin controls","Require pre-pin behavior files","Upload pre-pin behavior JUnit"];const titles=["prepin linux verifier: accepts the newest successful exact-head artifact and ignores filtered skips","prepin linux verifier: refuses a newest failure that has an older success, a missing run, a bad stamp, a bad target, a missing gh, and a failed download","prepin linux verifier: the upload still runs after a failed control, and a missing junit or head file fails the job"];const helpers=[["PREPIN_TITLES",/\bPREPIN_TITLES\b/],["WorkflowStep",/\bWorkflowStep\b/],["parseValidateSteps",/\bparseValidateSteps\b/],["simulatePrepin",/\bsimulatePrepin\b/],["prepinJunit",/\bprepinJunit\b/],["writeFakeGh",/\bwriteFakeGh\b/],["runPrepinVerifier",/\brunPrepinVerifier\b/]];const present=names.filter(n=>wf.includes(n)).concat(titles.filter(t=>tf.includes(t))).concat(helpers.filter(p=>p[1].test(tf)).map(p=>"helper:"+p[0]));if(fs.existsSync("scripts/verify-prepin-linux-evidence.ts"))present.push("verifier still present");if(wf.includes("prepin-behavior"))present.push("workflow still names prepin-behavior");if(wf.includes("b53d13d"))present.push("workflow still names b53d13d");if(present.length)throw new Error("retired route still present: "+JSON.stringify(present));console.log("retired route and exclusive helpers absent");'

bun -e 'const fs=require("fs"),cp=require("child_process");const base=Bun.YAML.parse(cp.execSync("git show c2c73bc1dd4417e0dd40a0116fb64b88db272de2:.github/workflows/validate.yml",{encoding:"utf8"}));const cur=Bun.YAML.parse(fs.readFileSync(".github/workflows/validate.yml","utf8"));const six=["Checkout exact head for pre-pin behavior","Install exact-head dependencies","Stamp pre-pin behavior head","Run pre-pin controls","Require pre-pin behavior files","Upload pre-pin behavior JUnit"];const removed=base.jobs.validate.steps.map(s=>s.name).filter(n=>six.includes(n));if(removed.length!==6)throw new Error("expected six removed historical steps, found "+removed.length+": "+JSON.stringify(removed));base.jobs.validate.steps=base.jobs.validate.steps.filter(s=>!six.includes(s.name));if(JSON.stringify(base)!==JSON.stringify(cur))throw new Error("workflow differs beyond the six removed steps");console.log("whole workflow matches baseline minus the six steps");'

T-002.Title: Invalidate and regenerate the measured test-metrics.json

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Red first: the artifact guard below fails because the committed test-metrics.json still names prepin linux verifier and lacks prepin CI retirement. Then create a unique empty run directory with mkdtemp under os.tmpdir(), assert it is outside every git repository, record its absolute path at .ngrace/scratch/prepin-ci-phase2-t002/junit-dir.txt, invalidate the committed test-metrics.json so the runner's file-set-and-count-sum freshness predicate cannot leave it untouched, and run the artifact-producing action exactly once: bun -e 'const fs=require("fs"),path=require("path"),os=require("os"),cp=require("child_process");const d=fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(),"ngrace-prepin-t002-"));const top=cp.spawnSync("git",["-C",d,"rev-parse","--show-toplevel"],{encoding:"utf8"});if(top.status===0)throw new Error("temp dir is inside a git repository: "+top.stdout.trim());if(fs.readdirSync(d).length)throw new Error("run dir not empty");fs.mkdirSync(".ngrace/scratch/prepin-ci-phase2-t002",{recursive:true});fs.writeFileSync(".ngrace/scratch/prepin-ci-phase2-t002/junit-dir.txt",d+"\n");fs.rmSync("test-metrics.json",{force:true});const r=cp.spawnSync("bun",["run","test:metrics"],{stdio:"inherit",env:{...process.env,TMPDIR:d}});process.exit(r.status??1);' After it the artifact guard and the provenance check pass: the produced artifact's case multiset equals the single reporter JUnit in the recorded run directory, with the new guard title present, no removed verifier title, and no (provisional) entry. The provenance check fails closed when the recording is missing, the recorded directory is missing, or it holds zero or multiple ngrace-junit-*.xml files; it writes a sanitized dated transcript to .ngrace/scratch/prepin-ci-phase2-t002/provenance.json without removing the OS run directory; remove that directory and its pointer after close evidence. scripts/test-metrics.ts is not edited.

Verification.Command: bun -e 'const fs=require("fs");const a=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("test-metrics.json","utf8"));const removed=["prepin linux verifier"].filter(t=>a.tests.some(x=>x.name.includes(t)));const provisional=a.tests.filter(x=>x.name==="(provisional)");const sum=a.files.reduce((s,f)=>s+f.tests,0);if(removed.length||provisional.length||sum!==a.tests.length)throw new Error("stale artifact: removed="+JSON.stringify(removed)+" provisional="+provisional.length+" sum="+sum+"/"+a.tests.length);if(!a.tests.some(x=>x.name.includes("prepin CI retirement")))throw new Error("new guard title missing");console.log("artifact current:",a.tests.length,"cases");'
